A flat vowel tucks beneath the first sound; a standing one keeps to its right.

lines.junior: Why did you create the letters?
lines.master: Why did you devise the letters?

lines.rookie: Many people could not write what they meant.
lines.junior: Many people could not write down what they meant.
lines.master: Too many of my people could not write what they meant.

lines.rookie: I want everyone to learn them easily.
lines.junior: I want everyone to learn them with ease.
lines.master: I want everyone to learn them with ease.

lines.rookie: The King asks: "Who wrote this?"
lines.junior: The King asks: "Who wrote this?"
lines.master: The King asks: "Who wrote this?"

lines.rookie: Bun-i, a water-carrier. She cannot write Chinese characters.
lines.junior: Bun-i, a water-carrier. She cannot write Chinese characters.
lines.master: Bun-i, who carries water. Chinese characters are beyond her.

lines.rookie: She tried the characters on my gate first.
lines.junior: So she tried the characters on my gate first.
lines.master: So she reached for the characters on my gate.

lines.rookie: That does not show who wrote it.
lines.junior: That does not show who wrote it.
lines.master: That tells me nothing of who wrote it.

lines.rookie: The copied scrap shows the writer could not write Chinese characters.
lines.junior: The copied scrap shows that the writer could not write Chinese characters.
lines.master: The copied scrap shows the writer could not write Chinese characters.

lines.rookie: The King asks: "How can she write after only ten days?"
lines.junior: The King asks: "How can she write after only ten days of lessons?"
lines.master: The King asks: "How could she write after a mere ten days?"

lines.rookie: Your letters copy the mouth. They are easy to learn.
lines.junior: Your letters copy the mouth, so they are easy to learn.
lines.master: Your letters copy the mouth: they are simple to learn.

lines.rookie: Then my scholar was right. Ten days are enough.
lines.junior: Then my scholar was right: ten days are enough.
lines.master: Then my scholar was right. Ten days suffice.

lines.rookie: That does not show how she learned.
lines.junior: That does not show how she learned.
lines.master: That does not explain how she learned.

lines.rookie: Sora's board shows how the letters are made.
lines.junior: Sora's board shows how the letters are made.
lines.master: Sora's board shows how the letters are built.

lines.rookie: The King asks: "And you read it in one night?"
lines.junior: The King asks: "And you read it in a single night?"
lines.master: The King asks: "And you read it in a single night?"

lines.rookie: Taek's groups make 서고 지붕.
lines.junior: Taek's groups make 서고 지붕.
lines.master: Taek's groups spell 서고 지붕.

lines.rookie: The book hall roof! Open the book hall!
lines.junior: The roof of the book hall! Open the book hall!
lines.master: The book hall roof! Open the book hall at once!

lines.rookie: That does not say what she wrote.
lines.junior: That does not say what she wrote.
lines.master: That does not tell me what she wrote.

lines.rookie: Bun-i's note says 서고 지붕.
lines.junior: Bun-i's note says 서고 지붕.
lines.master: Bun-i's note reads 서고 지붕.
